outcome: resolution of cardiogenic and vasoplegic shock
cohort: A newborn presented with refractory cardiogenic and vasoplegic shock following cardiopulmonary bypass for atrioseptostomy and prostaglandin treatment due to hypoplastic left heart syndrome.
finding: A combination of mechanical circulatory support and cytokine hemoadsorption column (CytoSorb) successfully treated refractory shock in a newborn, allowing vasopressor weaning without multiple organ failure occurrence.
